result.summary:
Fixed three bugs in src/result.ts (tests and tsconfig untouched):
1. map (line 11): `return err(r)` wrapped the whole Err in a new Err, producing Err<Err<E>> and failing tsc; changed to `return r` to pass the Err through unchanged.
2. collect (line 25): the loop overwrote `failure` on every Err, so it returned the LAST error; added `if (failure === undefined)` to keep the FIRST error, as the test requires.
3. unwrapOr (line 32): `r.ok && r.value` discarded falsy Ok values (0, ""); changed to `r.ok ? r.value : fallback`.
Verification: `tsc --noEmit -p . && node --test` exits 0 — type check clean, all 4 tests pass.
